title: Ink sac to Ink pot
description: This texture pack changes the ink sac to ink pot pixelly.
body:
# Ink Pot
This resource pack changes the ink sac dropped by squid to an ink pot because I thought that it would be fun if they dropped ink pot and thus ink pot will be used to craft book and quill.

![Comparison between the change and original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1211f2a1aee8fb93ba4f9392588ed0c3243e5505.jpeg)
### Installation guide
- It is a simple texture pack and nothing too difficult in it for activating it in game so enable it like any other texture packs.
- If you use any other texture pack, then place it above it and play!
- Works fine in Optifine or Sodium
